about: Reviewed hits of the site's leak gate (scripts/leak-gate.mjs) that cannot be edited away here. A row for a dist/ path is settled by the scan of the built site; any other row by the scan of the tracked source tree (--tree). Each row covers exactly `count` hits of that kind (and salted hash prefix) in that file: one more is a new leak and one fewer is a stale row, and both fail the deploy. A canary is never listed. The list carries a review stamp (the sha256 of its rows): any change to a row without a new stamp stops the deploy, and a term of a class with no allowlist (the client, an employer, a publisher) can never be listed. A hit in a binary (its raw bytes or its metadata) is covered only by an exact row: the file sha256 and the offset of that one occurrence, count 1; a re-encoded file or a moved hit needs a new reviewed row.
